settings.text: We want to get your Anima Jewels pieces to you as safely and quickly as possible. Here is everything you need to know about our dispatch process and timelines.

settings.title: Free shipping over $35
settings.text: Enjoy free standard shipping on all orders over $35. For orders under $35, a flat standard shipping rate applies.

settings.title: Processing time
settings.text: All orders are processed and dispatched within 1–2 business days. You will receive a confirmation email with a tracking link the moment your package ships.

settings.title: Delivery timelines
settings.text: Standard delivery typically takes 3–7 business days after your order ships, depending on your location. Please allow extra time during holidays and sales events.

settings.title: US delivery only
settings.text: We currently ship within the United States only.
Please ensure your shipping address is entered completely and accurately at checkout. We cannot be held responsible for packages delayed or returned due to incorrect addresses.
